Become an Ortoo

Your café, shop or gym becomes an Ortoo in the Nutag game, and players come to you to order.

  • Every order is a part. Each time a player orders at your place they receive one part of a Ger. With all eight they build their Ger at your place.
  • They come back. A Ger falls unless its owner visits at least once a week, so a player who built one with you keeps returning.
  • You are on the map. Your Ortoo shows on the app's map and in the "Nearby" list.
